Release notes/v0.6.2/Oct 19, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.6.2.

Cadence now checks your own work before it proposes anything, so you don't get asked to start things you've already done.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 Changed

  • Already done? Cadence checks first. Before a proposal reaches your Inbox, Cadence looks for the same work in commits on every branch of every project you have a goal for, in the code, and in what you've asked your agents for. If you already built it, shipped it a different way, or worked on that area in the last few days, it doesn't propose it. Proposals already waiting get the same check once.
  • Already done is a new answer on proposal cards (press 4). It tells Cadence you did it, and never counts against its picks.

Get Cadence

Free for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 13 or later. The download is always the newest version.
